easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
